sources.note: Brief specifies mm dimensions, 0.5 mm elements, and 15 N thrust; use mm and N.
Envelope 150 mm along x, 20 mm along y, 20 mm along z; z up. Tool origin is the minimum corner.
Aluminium 7075 is stated. Brief omits elastic constants and temper; assume homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity with E=71700 N/mm^2 (71.7 GPa), nu=0.33.
Brief specifies 0.2; interpreted per tool convention as the fraction of non-passive design volume, excluding the required solid pad.
Brief specifies 0.5 mm elements; h=0.5 mm.
Brief clamps the entire root end face x=0 in the frame; fix x,y,z translations at all its nodes.

Brief states total 15 N along +z acting on the pad top face. Assume equal nodal distribution across that full face x=130..150,y=0..20,z=20; rectangular patch center (140,10) and size (20,20) are derived from the stated extents.
Brief requires a kept-solid pad x=130..150, full width y=0..20, z=15..20 mm.

spec.description: Drone arm, x along its length and z upward. Isotropic linear-elastic aluminium 7075; assumed E=71.7 GPa and Poisson ratio 0.33. Volume fraction 0.2 applies to the non-passive design volume; the solid motor pad is excluded by tool convention.
